title: Memory Chat startup measurements
method: Fresh temporary corpus for each sample; actual installed SDK, native Gateway, authenticated RPCs and persisted transcripts. Two sequential messages use immediate labelled local model protocol replies.

samples.name: Before: per-call CLI transport, no preparation
samples.transport: A new OpenClaw CLI process for each Gateway RPC

samples.name: After: persistent native transport, no preparation
After: persistent native transport and background preparation

interpretation: Persistent RPC transport removed repeated CLI process startup from subsequent calls.
Background preparation starts and authenticates native memory before messaging; it made zero model calls.
Preparation moved roughly 15 seconds before the first message in this sample; it did not remove native startup work.
The first agent execution still performs native lazy initialization after memory is ready.
limits: One sample per configuration, not a median, percentile, performance guarantee or controlled benchmark.
These are Linux cloud timings; no macOS speed claim is established.
Local fixture replies exclude real provider network/inference latency and establish no genuine model or recall behavior.
Cold means a fresh native process and corpus, not a cleared operating-system file cache.
The prepared first-turn timing starts after preparation; total time from server launch includes preparationSeconds.

reproduce.prerequisites: Install the pinned runtime and Python SDK chat dependencies. No API key is required. Run from the repository root.
